blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn As (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: اللهِ ﷺ: يَا عَبْدَ اللهِ لَا تَكُنْ مِثْلَ فُلَانٍ كَانَ يَقُومُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَتَرَكَ قِيَامَ اللَّيْلِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب مايكره من ترك قيام الليل لمن كان يقومه رقم:١١٥٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “O Abdullah! Do not become like so-and-so, who used to pray Tahajjud at night and then gave it up.” Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn As (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this to him.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The meaning of this hadith is that it is not proper to give up one's regular deed of Deen without a valid reason.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْمُطَّلِبِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: صَلَاةُ اللَّيْلِ مَثْنَي مَثْنَي وَإِذَا صَلَّي أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَتَشَهَّدْ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ لْيُلْحِفْ فِي الْمَسْئَلَةِ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَا فَلْيَتَسَاكَنْ وَلْيَتَبَاَّسْ وَلْيَتَضَعَّفْ فَمَنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ ذلِكَ فَذَاكَ الْخِدَاجُ أَوْ كَالْخِدَاجِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: “The night Salah is two by two rak'ahs, so whenever any of you prays, let him recite the “Tashahhud” (At-Tahiyyat) at the end of every two rak'ahs; then let him plead earnestly in Du'a and express his helplessness, his destitution and his weakness. The Salah of one who does not do this is incomplete, or like something incomplete.” Hazrat Muttalib ibn Rabi'ah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.text:
Explanation:- The Du'a after the Tashahhud may be made both within the Salah and after giving the Salam.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ ﵄ أَنَّهُ مَرَّ بِالنَّبِيِّ ﷺ لَيْلَةً وَهُوَ
